name: motionboard
description: Original, editable motion graphics from a script or a video clip: full animation or timed B-roll, native 16:9, 9:16 and square, brand kits, MP4 or transparent ProRes for Final Cut.

interface.shortDescription: Original motion graphics from a script or clip.
interface.longDescription: Plan and design original animated scenes from a script, voiceover or video clip, as full animation or B-roll timed over the footage, in 16:9, 9:16 or square and in your brand kit. Renders MP4 or transparent ProRes 4444, and opens a visual editor that stays in sync with the project.
defaultPrompt: Make vertical motion graphics for this script with Motionboard.
Add Motionboard B-roll graphics over this clip.
Make an animated lower third for this interview.
